name: Cape Kidnappers Golf Course
description: A world Top 100 clifftop masterpiece designed by Tom Doak, featuring a dramatic ridge-and-valley layout high above Hawke's Bay. Stunning ocean views, bold bunkering, and unforgettable par threes make it one of the most spectacular golf experiences on the planet.

name: Hawkes Bay Golf Club
description: The main parkland course in the Art Deco city of Napier, with a welcoming visitor policy that makes it easy to get a game. A well-maintained layout in one of Hawke's Bay's sunniest and most vibrant destinations.

name: Takapau Golf Club
description: Built in 1898, this well-maintained country course in Central Hawke's Bay features interesting holes set around a meandering stream. Multiple tee configurations, including a Red course for young and casual players, ensure golfers of all abilities are well catered for in this historic rural setting.

name: Norsewood Golf Club
description: A quaint 9-hole country course in the Scandinavian-heritage town of Norsewood, offering a fun and challenging layout for golfers of all levels. The course measures 5,281 metres over 18 holes and is open year-round, providing an authentic rural New Zealand golfing experience in the Tararua District.

name: Maraenui Golf Club
description: A challenging course in Napier with over 800 members and modern facilities.

name: Puketitiri Golf Club
description: A rural 9-hole in the Puketitiri valley inland from Napier.

name: Te Pohue Golf Club
description: A small backcountry 9-hole on SH5 between Napier and Taupo.

name: Cape Turnagain Golf Club
description: A rugged 9-hole coastal course perched near Cape Turnagain in Hawke's Bay, where the biggest challenge is the ever-present wind. Located about an hour's drive from Dannevirke, this remote course rewards adventurous golfers with a wild, windswept setting along the eastern coastline.

name: Karamu Golf Club
description: A friendly public course situated on State Highway 2, just north of Hastings, taking its name from the Karamu Stream that meanders around the layout. Founded in 2011, the club is conveniently located between Napier, Hastings, and Havelock North, offering a relaxed atmosphere with a driving range and mini golf on site.

name: Onga Onga Golf Club
description: A picturesque 9-hole course nestled in the peaceful surroundings of the Forest Gate domain along Highway 50 in Central Hawke's Bay. Dual tees on front and back nines ensure variety across a full 18-hole round, with well-groomed fairways and a relaxed country atmosphere.

name: Waipawa Golf Club
description: A friendly 12-hole country course in Central Hawke's Bay where booking a tee time is seldom necessary. The relaxed, welcoming atmosphere and easy-going pace make it an ideal stop for golfers exploring the region.

name: Hastings Golf Club
description: A long-established club set in the orchard country of Hastings, offering a well-maintained parkland layout in the heart of Hawke's Bay. The mature tree-lined fairways and pleasant surroundings make for an enjoyable round in one of New Zealand's premier fruit-growing regions.

name: Porangahau Golf Club
description: Founded in 1927, this free-draining 9-hole links course sits on the stunning east coast of Central Hawke's Bay, offering sea views and alternate tee grounds for variety. Part of the Porangahau Country Club, the course is about 30 minutes from Waipukurau and enjoys a beautiful coastal backdrop near Porangahau Beach.

name: Napier Golf Club (Waikouaiti)
description: A traditional Napier club featuring a well-kept parkland layout with mature trees and gentle contours. The course provides a solid test of golf in the sunny Hawke's Bay region, with a welcoming atmosphere for visitors and members alike.

name: Pongaroa Golf Club
description: A welcoming 9-hole course set amidst rural scenery and mature pine trees, located one kilometre west of Pongaroa village. Visitors are always welcome for a relaxing round on this charming country layout in the Tararua District.

name: Havelock North Golf Club
description: A pleasant parkland club in the acclaimed wine village of Havelock North, offering well-maintained fairways surrounded by the rolling hills and vineyards of Hawke's Bay. The welcoming club provides a fine complement to the area's renowned food and wine scene.

name: Dannevirke Golf Club
description: An affordable rural club in Dannevirke offering a relaxed round in the southern Hawke's Bay countryside. The course suits golfers of all levels and provides good value in a friendly, no-fuss setting.

name: Waipukurau Golf Club
description: A rural parkland course in the heart of Central Hawke's Bay, providing a pleasant test of golf with tree-lined fairways and well-maintained greens. The relaxed country atmosphere and affordable play make it a popular choice for locals and visitors to the Waipukurau area.

name: Mahia Golf Club
description: A remote 9-hole links on the beautiful Mahia Peninsula, where dramatic coastal scenery and ocean breezes create a memorable round. The isolated setting on the eastern tip of Hawke's Bay rewards golfers willing to make the journey with stunning views and a true links experience.
